goal: The run-detail CLI JSON surfaces every landing decision on a run -- gate verdicts with grader output, parks, redrives, landings -- from the store alone, with secret-shaped values redacted by default.

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py -- _cmd_show / _run_detail_to_dict / _print_run_detail; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/audit/ -- reuse its redaction rules for rendered excerpts
references: .flywheel/specs/00073-FEATURE-run-decision-record.md -- criteria 8, 10 and the retrieval halves of 1, 2, 3, 5; decision D-5
constraints: Decision records come from the store; deleting the run's telemetry JSONL must not affect them (criterion 8)
Default rendering redacts secret-shaped values; the existing raw flag reveals them (criterion 10)
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not change the audit verb (audit-landing-stream owns the stream view)
Do not alter status/live surfaces beyond keeping their tests green
Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: Run JSONL deleted: decisions still retrievable, exit 0
A secret-shaped token inside a persisted excerpt renders redacted by default
A run with no landing decisions renders without error
